description: Read the most recent Google reviews of a local business: star rating, what the customer wrote, and the date. Give the business name and city, or a place_id from business_listings. Use it to judge a business's reputation or see what customers complain about. Price: $0.05 per successful call; failed calls are free.

api_key.description: Your Unstuck API key, if this connection has none. Leave empty to try free tools or to get a key and payment link.

business.description: Business name, e.g. "Joe's Pizza". Use with location.

place_id.description: Google place_id (from business_listings), instead of name + location.

name: business_reviews

business.description: Business name as Google lists it.

charged_usd.description: Amount charged for this call, USD.

date.description: Review timestamp, or a relative time like "2 weeks ago".

title: Read Google Reviews
